selection_metric: best_valid_score = mean DE-NORMALIZED validation Huber loss (STFGNN.calculate_loss = huber_loss(delta=rho=1), lower is better); report test MAE/RMSE/masked-MAPE alongside
example_command: python run_hyper.py --task traffic_state_pred --model STFGNN --dataset PEMSD7 --params_file documentation/STFGNN_search_space.run_hyper.txt --hyper_algo grid_search --max_epoch 5 --gpu True --gpu_id 1 --exp_id stfgnn_tune

paper_benchmark.source: STFGNN AAAI 2021, Table 2 (arXiv:2012.09641v2); verified by result-analyzer
paper_benchmark.paper_training_recipe: Adam lr=1e-3, batch=32, epochs=200, 3 STSGCL layers, filters 64, Huber delta=1

rationale.learning_rate: Top-leverage parameter. Paper anchor = 1e-3 (verified in the original repo configs). The paper uses an Adam + PolyScheduler(pwr=2, warmup=1 epoch) recipe; LibCity config runs a CONSTANT lr (lr_decay=false). Under a short per-trial budget (5 epochs) a constant lr is effectively more aggressive than the paper's warm-started schedule, so the grid brackets 1e-3 with one value below (0.0005, guards stability) and two above (0.002, 0.005, offset the short budget / underfit).
rationale.batch_size: Paper uses 32; the migrated LibCity config default is 64. This is a genuine paper-vs-config divergence, and batch size strongly affects optimization dynamics and effective step count per epoch, so both are tested. (Note: batch_size is part of LibCity's dataset cache key, so switching it regenerates the cached dataset once.)
rationale.first_layer_embedding_size: The input-projection width; paper and config both use 64. The migrated model already has ~13.4M params on PEMSD7 (883 nodes), so both a smaller (32, capacity/regularization probe) and a larger (128) value are informative around the verified 64 center.

assumptions: Paper hyperparameters (lr=1e-3, batch=32, epochs=200, filters [[64,64,64]]x3, Huber rho=1) are taken from the original repo configs config/*/individual_3layer_12T.json as recorded in documentation/STFGNN_repo_analysis.md; they were NOT re-read from a paper PDF in this task.
Paper benchmark metrics are those verified by result-analyzer from Table 2 (arXiv:2012.09641v2), not independently re-derived here.

Tuning is run at per_trial_max_epoch=5 (not the shipped max_epoch=100) purely to fit the trial budget; the winning configuration must be re-trained at the full epoch budget before the final paper comparison.
dropout is NOT tunable: the migrated STFGNN model contains no dropout anywhere (confirmed in documentation/STFGNN_config_notes.md and STFGNN.py).
strides and filters are frozen because strides=4 is hard-coupled to the (4N,4N) fusion-graph builder and filters define the paper architecture.
